title: Multi-architecture comparison

decisions.models: convnext_tiny.fb_in1k (stronger CNN) and deit_small_patch16_224.fb_in1k (vision transformer), the first-priority candidates; chosen by the author on 2026-09-24 before inspect_models.py ran
decisions.scope: standard plan: both protocols for both models (4 runs, 10,000 samples each)
decisions.selection_check: summary/model_selection.json (inspect_models.py, committed before any A3 run). convnext_tiny passes conditions 1-3 and its model-space cell areas equal mobilenetv2_050's for every sample in both protocols. deit_small fails condition 3 (crop_pct 0.9 vs 0.875), as do the other two transformer candidates, so falling back would not help; deit_small is kept (deviations.md D-006).
decisions.comparison_rule: Implementation plan sections 4.5 and 6.1: the cross-architecture comparison over all four models uses the crop-free runs, where every model sees identical 224x224 geometry (verified: equal cell areas). Exact runs: mobilenetv2_050, mobilenetv2_100, and convnext_tiny are compared with each other (identical geometry); deit_small exact is reported per model, with its cell-area table against mobilenetv2_050 exact.

run_order: crop-free runs first (the protocol on which all four models are compared), then exact; one run at a time
config_rule: Copies of experiments/real_dataset_case_study/configs/imagenet_mnv2_050_{exact,crop_free}.yaml with only adapter.model_name and the relative data paths (one directory deeper) changed. Samples (data/phase3/imagenet/val_10_per_class.txt, 10,000), grid_4x4 regions, operators and seed_salts, controls (random_area_match, K=3), dataset_stats.channel_mean (the ImageNet mean, which is also both new models' normalization mean), runtime, and global_seed 20260820 are unchanged, so every target and control mask equals the mobilenetv2 runs' item for item.
execution: HF_HOME=/workspace/data/hf_cache python experiments/revision_1/common/run_matrix.py --matrix experiments/revision_1/a3_multi_arch/matrix.json --output-root experiments/revision_1/results/a3 --skip-report (run -> metrics -> analyze). Before launch, ssat estimate --json for each config is saved to results/a3/preflight/<run>.json.
run_checks: the weight file SHA-256 in HF_HOME after the runs equals model_selection.json
the clean content_hash of every sample equals the mobilenetv2_050 exact baseline's

the new runs' target and control item_id sets per sample equal the mobilenetv2_050 run of the same protocol (item_id does not depend on the model), and target effective_area_px equals the model-space areas in model_selection.json

populations.common_correct: per protocol, samples whose clean top-1 prediction is correct for all four models in that protocol
populations.model_correct: per run, samples that model classifies correctly (per-model tables only; pairwise comparisons use samples correct in both runs of the pair)

analyses.model_info: per run: model, timm name, parameters, weight SHA-256, preprocessing description, clean top-1 accuracy and n_correct over the 10,000 samples, K
analyses.region_profile: per run: 16-cell mean margin_drop (metrics/spatial_profile.parquet, mean over samples of the per-sample cell value), its within-model rank (1 = largest), and within-model z (cell mean minus the 16-cell mean, divided by the 16-cell std, ddof 0). Raw values are compared only within a model.
analyses.top_region_share: per run: share of samples whose largest-margin_drop cell is each cell (ties by region_key ascending, as in P0-2 and B1), and the corner / edge / center totals
analyses.reliability: per run: stored reliability.parquet margin_drop grade distribution (HIGH / MODERATE / LOW / UNRELIABLE, overall and per cell type), flag rates (sign_consistent, exceeds_control, seed_stable, multi_strategy, ci_excludes_zero, area_matched), and the operator-pair Spearman from analysis rank_correlation.parquet
analyses.cross_model: per protocol, every model pair: 16-cell mean-profile Spearman; per-sample 16-cell Spearman (median, IQR, p10, p90); top-1 cell agreement and Cohen's kappa over the 16 cells; top-3 overlap; anchor grade agreement and linear weighted kappa. Uses B1's compare_protocols helpers (profile_matrix, ranking_summary, grade_summary) with the same definitions.
analyses.yardstick: mobilenetv2_050 vs mobilenetv2_100 in the same protocol (same-family baseline). Cross-architecture pairs are read against it.
analyses.common_patterns: per protocol: whether the four center cells hold the four highest mean ranks in each model, the corner / edge / center top-region shares, and the HIGH share by cell type
analyses.deit_exact_area: deit_small exact target cell areas against mobilenetv2_050 exact (mean fraction by cell type and ratio), from the dump and model_selection.json

scale: margin_drop is in logit-margin units, whose scale differs across models (in particular the ViT's). Cross-model comparisons are rank-based; raw values appear only in per-model tables, and any z-normalized value is labeled as such.

figures: fig_a3_profiles.pdf (4 models x 2 protocols, 4x4 heatmaps coloured by within-model rank)
fig_a3_similarity.pdf (model x model profile and per-sample Spearman per protocol)
outputs.report: A3_REPORT.md: common patterns, architecture-specific differences, reliability differences (experiment plan section 7.4 step 4)

caveats: ViT 16-px patches do not align with the 56-px grid cells (3.5 patches per cell); the grid is not changed
clean accuracy and reliability grades are different concepts; their relation is described, not tested
differences between architectures are not read as SSAT failures (experiment plan section 7.7)
